steps.name: 01-crowded-doors.png
steps.scene: PAGE 1: the factory is spacious, the warehouse hatch is tiny. CAMERA high wide rear three-quarter view looking diagonally down across a mostly EMPTY factory floor. Girl at lower right, full body seen FROM BEHIND and slightly in profile, standing with a slouch and holding a simple folded floor plan, looking at ONE squat cuboid warehouse in the upper-left middle distance. The wide bare floor fills about HALF the canvas, with just a broad warm window-light rectangle. Show the contrast between tiny busy door and generous empty space. No additional machines or terminal ports; these arrive later in the chapter.
